outcomes.retrospective: Haus of Pixels proved that the most valuable client contributions often happen in strategic decision-making meetings rather than inside design software. By formalizing a corporate entity, we moved from producing isolated visual deliverables to executing integrated creative systems (brand discovery, vendor frameworks, print QA, and AI adoption). This systems-first thinking allowed us to build long-term advisory relationships where clients treat design as a strategic investment rather than an expense.
outcomes.status: Active operating studio, holding project IP and serving as the primary corporate structure for consulting, visual development, and AI transition contracts.

outcomes.retrospective: Pixelate was my self-designed university. Executing it was brutal, forcing me to learn cryptography, behavioral economics, mechanism design, smart contracts, and product leadership. While the token never reached production scale due to shifting market dynamics and the rise of synthetic media, it taught me to think from first principles and view products as interconnected systems. It became the foundation of all my subsequent startup and tech advisory work.
outcomes.status: Wound down in July 2024. The underlying research and systems thinking now serve as the structural framework for subsequent visual consulting.

caseStudies.summary: Pixelate began with a simple question: can photography become a self-sustaining digital economy? It grew into a multidisciplinary research collaboration across photography, blockchain, computational imaging, creator economies, governance and incentive design. Seven years produced a Startup Weekend win, four MVPs, an AMM design for camera-sensor photographs, and, after 100+ pitch rounds, selection into the NEAR Accelerator with a $15K Fast Grant.

caseStudies.title: Buddy Tales

pipeline.description: Building an animation production organisation from zero, no existing pipeline, no experienced team, no studio infrastructure, then running it end-to-end:

steps.title: Organisation Before Product
steps.desc: Before a single frame was animated, the entire production organisation had to be invented. Defined roles, set communication protocols, sourced remote animators and background artists, and established the accountability structure that would govern months of distributed work.

steps.title: Asset Architecture & Style Bible
steps.desc: Created character model sheets, colour palettes, background key studies, and a production style bible that could be handed to remote artists and produce consistent output across scenes, replacing verbal direction with documented standards.

steps.title: Remote Pipeline Execution
steps.desc: Orchestrated every stage of the animation pipeline across distributed collaborators: script breakdowns → scene layouts → rough animation passes → clean-up → ink & paint (colour fills) → compositing. Sequence tracking spreadsheets replaced a studio floor.

steps.title: Post-Production & Final Delivery
steps.desc: Supervised voiceover recording, dialogue sync, sound design, foley, and sound-effects layering. Managed the final render pipeline, quality-control review, and client delivery, closing the loop on a full television production cycle.

milestones.title: Hired as Director & Producer: Shivanata Production LLP
milestones.desc: Brought in by Savan Barot to lead what began as a branding engagement. Scope rapidly expanded into full production leadership of an animated television series with no existing infrastructure.

milestones.title: Production Systems Built from Scratch
milestones.desc: Assembled the remote team, defined every role, and created all production frameworks, scene tracking, revision protocols, asset delivery standards, before animation could begin.

milestones.title: Pipeline Running: Rough-to-Clean Animation Cycles
milestones.desc: Established the full rough → clean-up → colour → composite cycle across two remote animators and a background artist, maintaining quality and schedule simultaneously.

milestones.title: Post-Production Lock & Final Delivery
milestones.desc: Delivered series to client after supervising voiceover sync, sound design, and final render pipeline, completing the largest single production responsibility of my career to date.

outcomes.retrospective:
Buddy Tales was the hardest thing I have built. Not because the animation was complex, but because the entire production organisation had to be invented before the product could exist. There was no playbook. No experienced team. No studio. I had to act as producer, director, HR, operations manager, and creative lead simultaneously, sometimes in the same hour.

The central lesson: when working in a field without established infrastructure, the first deliverable is always the organisation itself. The series only existed because the systems existed first. Every subsequent frame was a consequence of the frameworks built in the first three weeks.

Building a remote pipeline for animation also taught me that the hardest problems in creative production are coordination problems, not craft problems. The scenes that failed did so because of unclear handoff protocols, not because of animation skill gaps. This insight now shapes how I approach every multi-person creative engagement.
outcomes.status: Completed and delivered. Shivanata Production LLP subsequently closed after 72 days of operation. The pipeline frameworks built for this series serve as the structural foundation for any large-scale remote creative production I take on.

caseStudies.summary: Buddy Tales began as a client contract in Dec 2023 and became my largest production responsibility: building an animation studio's team, systems and pipeline from zero. I ran 50+ interviews, hired and led a four-person remote team, and owned every script-to-screen decision through the 10-minute pilot.

milestones.desc: Migrated buttons, inputs, switches to Fluent UI Web Components v2.6.1 via CDN; token injection via CSS custom properties and ::part() selectors.

milestones.desc: Playwright E2E tests (6 passing), ESLint v9 flat config (0 errors), GitHub Actions CI pipeline.

milestones.desc: Beat-driven scroll engine, audio manager, camera rig, orb system, EXIF-enriched photography gallery (269 photos), indrajaal-style codex scroller, artifact view.

outcomes.retrospective:
Building this portfolio was an exercise in technical optimization. Combining complex Three.js render passes, GSAP camera movements, and Fluent UI elements without using a heavyweight bundler resulted in a fast-loading, immersive website.

The high-velocity sprint (200+ commits) reflects a deliberate choice: vanilla ES modules over frameworks, CDN dependencies over npm, and custom scripts over build tools. The knowledge graph (graphify) now maps 994 nodes / 1199 edges / 77 communities, making the codebase navigable at a glance. Every major system (terrain, story engine, gallery, roles/clients) is a named community in the graph.
outcomes.status: Active personal website and live portfolio, serving as a primary sandbox for creative tech experiments.
